pattern: A labelled region with a WAI-ARIA APG toolbar, a Breadcrumb navigation, a Tree View of folders, and the folder content as an APG listbox with multiple selection (focus stays on the listbox; aria-activedescendant names the active entry). Dialogs follow the APG dialog and alertdialog patterns.

roles.role: listbox with option children (list rows or grid tiles)

aria.value: position in the folder (options are virtualized)

keyboard.action: Previous or next entry (the row above or below in the grid view); selects it.
Previous or next tile in reading order.
First, last, or one page of entries.
Extend the selection from the anchor.
Move without selecting, then toggle the entry.
Open: folders are shown, files previewed.
Cut the selection; paste it into the current folder.
Cancel a cut, then clear the selection.
Move to the next entry whose name starts with them.

focus: The listbox keeps focus while the active entry moves (aria-activedescendant), so virtualized scrolling never loses focus. After opening a folder focus stays in the content (an empty folder focuses its first action); after going up the folder you came from is active. Dialogs move focus inside and restore it on close; after a dialog the list is focused again.
notes: Every drag-and-drop move has a keyboard alternative (Ctrl+X, Ctrl+V, or the context menu), satisfying 2.5.7 Dragging Movements.
The status bar announces the item and selection counts; operations announce their result (created, renamed, moved, deleted, uploaded) and errors are shown as text and announced assertively.
Selection is shown by a bar or a ring as well as the fill, not by color alone.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Options in the grid view are grouped in presentational rows; screen readers announce them as one list.
